about.description: I have been pursuing my education at Universitas Muhammadiyah Semarang since 2023. During my studies, I have gained the basics of Java programming and have worked on various programs using Java and Python. Outside of college, I have also deepened my skills as a full-stack developer using Node.js, including completing two web-based projects during an internship. This combined experience has given me a foundation in building applications from backend to frontend, while developing a broader understanding of programming concepts. Besides academics and technology, I am also active as an influencer on TikTok and YouTube, which further hones my communication skills, content creativity, and interaction with digital audiences.
